a.text: I'll operate in round 1 as we agreed. One concern: storms hit 80% of the time after each round, so waiting to reach 8 means we'll very likely both fail. The reserve holds only 4, so just one of us can be covered right now. If you want to change the plan, tell me and propose a fair way to decide who takes first, like the reserve-parity rule or a split. Until we both agree to a change, I'll stick to the original plan and won't take early.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.
